# SCPHR - Suryadatta College of Pharmacy

> SCPHR is a PCI-approved pharmacy college in Pune offering B.Pharm and D.Pharm programs with institutional excellence in pharmaceutical education and student welfare.

Suryadatta College of Pharmacy & Healthcare Research (SCPHR) is part of the Suryadatta Education Foundation and Suryadatta Group of Institutes. The college is affiliated with DBATU Pune and recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), offering comprehensive pharmacy education with strong emphasis on student support systems and institutional governance.
